name: nodejs-movy-data
description: Database-agnostic migration tool. Migrates schema and data between PostgreSQL, MySQL and MSSQL.

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/db apps/cli apps/runner && pnpm --filter @movy/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @movy/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @movy/db typecheck && pnpm --filter @movy/cli typecheck && pnpm --filter @movy/runner typecheck && pnpm --filter @movy/web typecheck
scripts.docker:up: docker compose up -d --build && docker compose up -d --wait --wait-timeout 600 web pg-lab mysql-lab mssql-lab
